title: CG-GLORE: A Conjugate Gradient-Based Global-Local Regularization Network for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2608.15246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose by acquiring fewer projection views, but the resulting inverse problem is highly ill-posed and often produces severe streak artifacts. Existing deep reconstruction methods have achieved promising performance, yet many rely on first-order updates or large regularization networks, which can be less effective in ill-conditioned settings. We propose \textbf{CG-GLORE}, a compact deep unrolling framework inspired by second-order optimization for sparse-view CT reconstruction. Each unrolled stage uses a CG-solved linear system based on a structured Hessian surrogate: it retains the physics-induced curvature of the data-fidelity term while using an identity approximation for the learned regularization term. Thus, the method is second-order-inspired rather than an exact Newton method for the full learned objective. To model image priors, we design a Global-Local Regularization Network

translated_title: CG-GLORE：一种基于共轭梯度的全局-局部正则化网络用于稀疏视图CT重建
translated_abstract: 稀疏视图计算机断层扫描（CT）通过获取更少的投影视图来降低辐射剂量，但由此产生的逆问题高度病态，常导致严重的条纹伪影。现有的深度重建方法已取得良好性能，但许多依赖于一阶更新或大型正则化网络，在病态条件下可能效果不佳。我们提出了\textbf{CG-GLORE}，一种受二阶优化启发的紧凑型深度展开框架，用于稀疏视图CT重建。每个展开阶段使用基于结构化Hessian近似求解的共轭梯度（CG）线性系统：它保留数据保真项的物理诱导曲率，同时对学习到的正则化项使用单位近似。因此，该方法受二阶启发，而非针对完整学习目标的精确牛顿方法。为了建模图像先验，我们设计了一个全局-局部正则化网络。
tldr: 该论文提出CG-GLORE，一种结合共轭梯度二阶优化和全局-局部正则化网络的紧凑深度展开框架，有效解决了稀疏视图CT重建中的病态问题和条纹伪影。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CG-GLORE, a compact deep unrolling framework combining conjugate gradient-based second-order optimization with a global-local regularization network, effectively addressing ill-posedness and streak artifacts in sparse-view CT reconstruction.
